description: Fruška Gora Marathon is a sporting competition and recreational event with a long tradition, held in the hilly and forested area of Fruška Gora near Novi Sad. The courses pass through natural beauty and numerous medieval Serbian monasteries, as well as through historical and cultural landmarks. The competitive routes are certified by ITRA and serve as qualifications for Ultra Trail Mont-Blanc. In addition to the competitive routes, there are nine recreational trails that promote a healthy lifestyle and nature conservation.
course_highlights: Courses pass through 97% forested terrain of Fruška Gora
Passing through medieval Serbian monasteries such as Grgeteg, Staro and Novo Hopovo, Jazak, and Bešenovo
Climbing to the highest peak of Fruška Gora (539 m) and descending past the Dumbovački waterfall
additional: The competitive routes are ITRA certified and serve as qualifications for Ultra Trail Mont-Blanc. There are 14 different trails of various lengths and elevation differences, ranging from an ultra-extreme marathon of 134 km to recreational routes. The courses include natural and cultural landmarks, as well as historical sites. The organizer also has a Viber group for registration and communication. 14 routes of different lengths, certified by ITRA, including ultra and recreational distances, passing through medieval monasteries, natural and cultural landmarks.

name: Šumadija Trejl Staza Snage (Gledićke Planine)
description: Šumadija Trail Race is a challenging race through the pristine nature of the Gledić Mountains, featuring two courses that test runners' strength and endurance. The longer Prkos course is 17.5 km with 1000 meters of elevation gain, while the shorter Zamah course is 8 km with 450 meters of elevation gain. The race combines steep ascents and technical descents, offering a unique challenge and an opportunity to enjoy Šumadija hospitality. The start and finish are at Adžine Livade, and runners receive a rich start package and a surprise lunch.
course_highlights: Prkos Course: 17.5 km with 1000 m elevation gain
Zamah Course: 8 km with 450 m elevation gain
Highest point: Cerovi Peak 775 m, lowest 330 m
additional: Packet pickup is exclusively on race day from 08:00 to 09:45 at the start zone. Cut-off times are 5h30min for Prkos and 3h30min for Zamah. The start package includes a medal, dry fit t-shirt, race bib with chip, refreshments, professional photos, marked trail, aid stations, and a surprise lunch. Prizes are prepared for the best in the short course, especially for men and women. The event is scheduled for April 25, 2026, at Kragujevac / Adžine Livade. More information will be available on the organizer's Instagram page.

The start is on April 25, 2026, in Adžini Livadi, beginning at 10:00 AM for the longer route and 10:30 AM for the shorter one.

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Sky Heights Race on Zlatibor represents the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Mountaineering Club Tornik from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: a longer red course of 21 km with 1400 meters of elevation gain intended for seniors, and a shorter blue course of 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain for juniors. The courses pass through pristine nature of Zlatibor, crossing peaks such as Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering attractive and wild landscapes. The race gathers competitors from all over Serbia and abroad, and the scoring in the National Series is regulated by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA).
course_highlights: Two loop courses: 21 km with 1400 m elevation gain and 10 km with 500 m elevation gain
Courses pass over peaks Ljujaš (1269 m), Orlić (1235 m), Jelova Gora (1311 m), Bandera-Tornik (1496 m), and Liska (1346 m)
Race runs through untouched nature and lesser-known parts of Zlatibor
additional: The race base is at the elementary school in the village of Jablanica. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series with five rounds for seniors and three races for juniors. Participation requires a validated competition book from the Serbian Mountaineering Association (PSS) or a medical certificate. Senior scoring includes bonus points from the national championship and ultra trail races. The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain trails, and the race is part of a broader national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

description: Ivanjica Trail is a unique trail race in Serbia that brings together runners of various skill levels through several routes of different lengths and difficulties. The races are held in beautiful natural areas of Ivanjica and Golija, with viewpoints, meadows, forests, and streams, providing an unforgettable outdoor running experience. Notably, the Golija PREMIUM race starts at the top of Golija, and the ULTRA 66K is a two-day stage race connecting three mountains and offering a challenge for experienced runners. Organizers provide start packages, refreshments, lunch, transportation, and accommodation for participants, creating a friendly and supportive atmosphere.

The first stage of ULTRA 66K starts at 11:00 AM, and the second at 09:00 AM the following day. The start package includes a bib number, finisher medal, refreshments, and lunch. More distances, a two-day event, a list of registered participants, technically challenging routes, electronic timing, start packages with medals and meals are available.

It was developed with the support of the Institute for Territorial Economic Development and the Regional Cooperation Council, aiming to promote cross-border tourism and preserve the natural beauty of the region. The trail is known for its Via Ferrata attractions that provide exciting experiences for hikers and nature lovers.

name: Ozren i Devica 2026
description: Hiking event Devica - Ozren, organized by PSK Pobeda, guides participants to ascend Mount Devica, one of the most beautiful and northernmost Balkan mountains. The trail passes through lush vegetation and limestone formations with numerous caves, including the ascent to Soko Grad and the Golem Kamen viewpoint, ending with a forest trail towards Ozren and the Ripaljka waterfall. The event is a one-day activity, departing from Belgrade early in the morning and returning in the evening. Participants must have a valid hiking card from the Serbian Hiking Association for 2026 and appropriate hiking gear.

Participants must bring a jacket, a thin cap, light gloves, a raincoat, sturdy shoes, gaiters, trekking poles, spare clothing, a flashlight, personal first aid kit, energy chocolates or nuts, magnesium for muscles, and at least 1.5-2 liters of water. There is no water on part of the trail. Organized lunch after the ascent or participants can bring food in their backpacks. Participants must have a valid hiking card for 2026. Equipment should include a jacket, cap, gloves, sturdy shoes, trekking poles, flashlight, first aid kit, food, and water.

name: Stazama Vuka Karadžića
description: Vuk Karadžić's paths is a circular race of 25 km with a total ascent of 1000 meters. The course runs from Vuk's memorial house through the shade of centuries-old Monastery forests, past forest streams and waterfalls to the 13th-century Trinoša Monastery, then across Small Tronoša and Lisine to Zajača, from where the Monastery candles trail leads to Velika Bobija and the Miličin konak ethnographic complex, then back to Tršić and Vuk's house where the finish line is. This race offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the natural beauty and cultural-historical landmarks of the region.

The start is at 8:30 PM in front of Avala Tower, and runners will enjoy a special atmosphere of nocturnal adventure with mandatory headlamp use. In addition to the race, a race village with food, drinks, and music will be organized at the start and finish areas. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the best in male and female categories for both distances.
course_highlights: Night race on Avala Mountain starting in front of Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music at the start and finish zones
additional: Mandatory use of headlamps. The total number of participants is limited to 500. The start package can be picked up in Belgrade ten days before the race. The registration fee is non-refundable but can be gifted. Changing clothes and leaving belongings is individual. Distances of 6 km and 10 km, mandatory headlamp use, participant limit of 500, start at 8:30 PM, in Belgrade, race village for visitors.

The race starts at 8:30 PM and offers a unique night experience of Avala Mountain with a race village for entertainment before, during, and after the race. Participants can choose between two distances, 6 km and 10 km, and the use of a headlamp is mandatory. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, with prizes for the best in men's and women's categories in both distances.
course_highlights: Night race at the plateau in front of Avala Tower
Two distances: 6 km and 10 km
Race village with food, drinks, and music at the start and finish zones

name: Dunavske Čarolije 2026
description: Dunavske Čarolije is a unique event in Čortanovci that combines running, cycling, orienteering, water jumps, hiking, movies, music, and volleyball. This sports and entertainment festival gathers participants of all ages and offers a variety of activities along the Danube coast. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, with a rich program that lasts throughout the day. We invite everyone to join and enjoy the charms of the Danube and sports challenges.
course_highlights: Running and cycling along the Danube coast
Orienteering and water jumps
Hiking and outdoor sports activities
additional: The event also includes film screenings, live music, and volleyball matches, creating a rich and diverse program for participants and visitors. Registration is open for the Inđija Trail 08 race, which is part of the Dunavske Čarolije series of events, with early registration discounts available.

name: Vlasina 2026
description: Vlasinsko Triathlon Self-Transcendence is a traditional race held at the beautiful Vlasina Lake near Vladičin Han. Participants can choose between Olympic, Sprint, Super Sprint, Super Kid, and Mini Kid triathlons, tailored to different ages and competition levels. The race is known for its atmosphere of self-transcendence and the support provided by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which promotes sport and spirituality. Each competitor receives a start number, a diploma, and a medal for completing the race.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the shore of Vlasina Lake with beautiful natural surroundings
Multiple distances adapted to different ages: from Mini Kid to Olympic triathlon
Changing rooms located in close proximity to the start and finish lines
additional: Registration is only complete upon payment of the registration fee. An exception for payment upon receipt of the start package must be approved in advance. Foreign competitors can pay upon receipt of the start package due to difficulties with international transfers. Changing rooms are provided near the start and finish lines. Participants compete at their own risk. Participation includes various competition categories, information on registration, water conditions, drafting rules, and accommodation suggestions in the area.

name: Bukovački maraton 2026
description: Bukovac Marathon - The Long Route is a challenging hiking race held on Fruška Gora, starting and finishing in Bukovac. The route length is 47.8 km with a total ascent and descent of 1350 meters each. The trail is well-maintained and marked with a red and white hiking marker, passing by significant sites such as the Novo Hopovo Monastery, Old Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, Velika Remeta, as well as Brankov Grave and Monument. The race is intended for experienced hikers and runners who want to experience the nature and cultural heritage of Fruška Gora.
course_highlights: Route length of 47.8 km with a total ascent and descent of 1350 m
Passing by Novo Hopovo Monastery, Old Hopovo, Grgetek, Krušedol, and Velika Remeta
Well-maintained and marked trail with red and white hiking markers
additional: The trail was mapped out in 2004 and last marked in 2014. The start and finish are in Bukovac at an altitude of 180 meters. The estimated time to complete the trail is about 12 hours. The trail is demanding and intended for experienced hikers. There are control points (CP) along the route. The trail race with a marked route and control points at attractive locations takes place on the second Saturday of September, starting at 9:30 AM.

name: Arilje TRAIL
description: Arilje Trail is a race that combines challenge, nature, and adventure in the heart of western Serbia. Participants can choose between three routes of different lengths and difficulty levels: Green route (8 km, 250 m elevation), Blue route (18 km, 900 m elevation), and Red route (31 km, 1200 m elevation). The race passes through beautiful landscapes of the Rzav River, Žuta Stena, and the foothills of Arilje, offering technically demanding sections and unforgettable scenery. This event gathers runners of all levels, from recreational to professional, and provides a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and sport.
course_highlights: Trails through dense forests and clear mountain streams
Beautiful viewpoints and landscapes of the Rzav River and Žuta Stena
Technically demanding sections with significant ascents
additional: After the race, participants can enjoy free food, refreshments, and live music. There is also a children's race with different categories based on age. Organizers emphasize respect for nature, safety, and fair play, as well as mandatory wearing of race bibs and adherence to race rules. Multiple route lengths (8 km, 14 km, 18 km, 31 km), volunteer and local support, a rich start package, and an organized closing festival.

description: Radmilovac Trail is a unique race held in the green oasis of Radmilovac nature, near Belgrade. The race passes through orchards, vineyards, and fish ponds, offering runners beautiful natural landscapes and a pleasant atmosphere. In addition to the standard 5 km and 10 km races, there is a special academic category intended for PhD holders and doctoral students, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle. The organizers are the Zemun Faculty of Agriculture and AGRIF runners, and the event is known for its rich start package and prizes for the best competitors.
course_highlights: Track through orchards, vineyards, and fish ponds
Natural oasis Radmilovac with the Small Danube
Close to Belgrade, only 14 km from the center
additional: The start package includes a bib number, electronic timing, electronic diploma, finisher medal, eco-friendly multi-purpose bag, and surprises. Parking is provided, and GSP bus lines are available to the location. After the race, there is a gathering with food, drinks, and music, and the number of participants is limited to the 150 fastest registered runners. Trail terrain, medals, T-shirts, and event organization services are provided.

name: 10. Zrenjaninski polumaraton
description: The Zrenjanin Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Zrenjanin since 2016 and is known as one of the best-organized half marathon races in Serbia. The course is 21.1 km long, flat, and circular, passing through the most beautiful parts of the city, including the neighborhoods of 4. July and Ruža Šulman, with the start in front of the City Hall. In addition to the half marathon, the race offers disciplines of 7 km, 14 km, Nordic walking, and a 3x7 km relay, allowing participation for runners of different levels and ages. This event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community, and runners become part of the story of a city with a big heart and generous hosts.
course_highlights: The course is 21.1 km long, flat, and circular without major ascents
Three laps through the most beautiful parts of Zrenjanin, including neighborhoods 4. July and Ruža Šulman
Start in front of the City Hall in the city center
additional: Disciplines organized: half marathon 21.1 km, 14 km race, 7 km fun run, 7 km Nordic walking, and 3x7 km relay. Registrations are done via the portal trka.rs. The organizer provides medical assistance and refreshments on the course at intervals of up to 5 km. Participants compete at their own risk, and written consent is required for minors. Participation is possible in various categories, and applications are submitted through the portal trka.rs. The race is known for good organization and a friendly atmosphere.

description: Župska vinska trka is a unique sports and wine event held in the beautiful landscape of Župa, a renowned wine region in central Serbia. The race combines wine and sports enthusiasts along a course that passes through vineyards, mountains, and cultural-historical sites such as the medieval town of Koznik. Participants enjoy tastings at refreshment stations, receive an official race shirt, finisher medal, and other souvenirs. The event promotes the rich tradition and natural beauty of the area. The race starts at 12:00 PM, and race packets can be collected until 11:00 AM.
course_highlights: The course passes through vineyards and gentle slopes of Župa
Views of the surrounding mountains Kopaonik, Željin, Goč, and Jastrebac
Passing by the medieval town of Koznik
additional: The registration fee includes tastings at refreshment stations and a mini fair, an official race shirt, race bib, finisher medal, a gift bag, souvenirs, and catering at the refreshment stations and finish line. Race packets can be collected until 11:00 AM on race day. Participation includes tastings, a race shirt, medal, souvenirs, and catering. Online registration is available until August 31, 2026. The event takes place in the vineyards and nature of Župa, with the race starting at 12:00 PM and race packets to be collected by 11:00 AM.

name: Rajac 2026
description: Rajsko mowing is a traditional event held since 1892, on the first Sunday after Petrovdan. This event gathers mowers dressed in traditional peasant attire who compete in manual grass cutting on prepared plots. In addition to the competition, the program includes an exhibition of mowing tools, folklore performances, and cultural-artistic content, providing a unique atmosphere and preserving folk tradition.
course_highlights: Manual grass cutting on plots measuring 20×6 meters
Traditional peasant attire of the mower
International team competition in manual grass cutting
additional: The competition takes place on plots measuring 20×6 meters, where mowers cut in two passes. The cutting is judged based on speed and quality, and the winner receives recognition. Mowers must arrive with their own mowing equipment and wear mandatory traditional attire. The program also includes an exhibition of tools, folklore performances, and a trumpet orchestra concert. Events include traditional activities, hiking tours, and trail marking courses, with a focus on preserving and promoting the natural and cultural values of Rajac.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori
description: Autumn Hiking Marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports and recreational event that gathers runners on challenging trails through the beautiful nature of Fruška Gora. The races cover various distances, from ultra-extreme to preparatory trails, adapted to different levels of readiness. The event takes place in Popovica near Sremska Kamenica and offers a unique combination of challenge and enjoyment of nature. Organizers provide organized transportation to the start, as well as rich support during the race.
course_highlights: Ultra-extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Preparatory trails with 1-2 ITRA points
additional: Organized transportation to the marathon start from Novi Sad at 6 AM on Saturday. There is a division into individual and group registrations, as well as 'Sport' and 'Fun' categories. Starting packages are collected before the race. Races are scored by the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories. Terrain: forest and hilly paths, registration on the organizer's website, focus on enjoyment and promotion of nature.

name: Jesenji planinarski maraton na Fruškoj gori 2026
description: Autumn hiking marathon on Fruška Gora is a traditional sports-competition and recreational event that gathers mountain running and nature enthusiasts. The races take place on challenging trails passing through beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora, with various lengths and difficulties, suitable for participants of different levels. The event is known for good organization, a rich program, and support from numerous sponsors and friends of the marathon. Participants can expect challenges on trails with significant ascents and descents, as well as unforgettable natural scenery.
course_highlights: Trails pass through forested areas and mountain peaks of Fruška Gora
Ultra extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points and Ultra marathon with 4 ITRA points
Apprentice trails and the trail of joy and satisfaction for less experienced runners
additional: Organized transportation from Novi Sad to the marathon start on Saturday at 6 AM. There is an option to register on-site on Saturday at Popovica for FUN trails. Start packages are collected just before the race. Trails are scored according to the ITRA system, with different difficulty categories from apprentice to ultra extreme marathons. Participants can download GPX route files, and the event is open to all healthy and capable individuals. The marathon takes place in autumn, in the nature of Fruška Gora, with a special emphasis on enjoying nature and physical activity.

name: Povlen Trail
description: Povlen Trail is part of the West Serbia Trails series, which connects mountains, rivers, and valleys of western Serbia through unique trail races. This race offers runners the opportunity to explore pristine nature and enjoy the challenges of mountain trails. West Serbia Trails promotes the combination of sport, nature, and community, creating an unforgettable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with untouched nature of western Serbia
Diverse terrains connecting mountains, rivers, and valleys
Authentic experience of nature and local culture
additional: West Serbia Trails is a series of trail races and hiking events that includes other races such as Divča Winter Trail, Jablanik Trail, Vidra Gradac Trail, and others. The races are known for a strong community, international ITRA points, and UTMB index, motivating runners at the international level. The event is part of the Trail Liga Timova, a team competition based on kilometers covered, with early registration and more favorable prices.

name: Viking Challenge Trail
location: Fruška Gora - Planinarski dom Jedinstvo, Fruška Gora, Serbia
description: Viking Challenge is a race held on Fruška Gora, with routes of various lengths suitable for all ages and running levels. Participants can choose between routes of 1 km to 22 km, enjoying well-marked terrains and volunteer support. The race offers electronic timing, medals, promotional t-shirts, as well as refreshments and a meal after the race. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, emphasizing community and sporting energy.
course_highlights: Routes of 1 km, 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km on Fruška Gora
Well-marked trails with volunteer and audience support
Electronic timing and available GPX files for navigation
additional: Start in groups according to registration dates with no possibility of rescheduling. Participants receive a medal, promotional t-shirt, race photos, water, juices and energy drinks, as well as a meal after the race. Medical assistance is available in case of injury. Trail race, electronic timing, available GPX files for route, post-race gathering.

name: Gledić Ultra trejl 2026
description: Gledić Ultra Trail is a mountain race that takes place through the pristine nature of the Gledić Mountains, offering three routes of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners will enjoy beautiful landscapes, forests, meadows, and viewpoints while testing their endurance and willpower. This event gathers nature and adventure enthusiasts, providing a unique running experience through authentic Serbian terrains. The start package includes a T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, refreshment stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and a meal for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain trails through forests, meadows, and ridges
Viewpoints with panoramic views
Three routes: 12 km (530 m ascent), 22 km (930 m ascent), 55 km ultra (2050 m ascent)
additional: The start package includes a race logo T-shirt, medal, chip-timed bib, refreshment stations, professional photographs, sponsor gifts, and a meal for participants. The trails are well marked and secured. The time limit for the longest route is 12 hours, and for the middle route 6 hours. The event is part of regional trail and ultramarathon events, focusing on promoting a healthy and active lifestyle in nature.

name: Ovčar 2026
description: Kablar Skyrace is a mountain race held in the spectacular Ovčarsko-kablarske Gorge area, with start and finish in Ovčar Banja. The race is 22.4 km long with a cumulative ascent of 1600 meters, passing through wooded areas, technically demanding rock sections, and over two peaks of Kablara, offering runners challenges and beautiful panoramic views of the Western Morava River and surrounding mountains. This race is part of the national series of the Mountain Rescue Service of Serbia and is intended for both experienced runners and recreational athletes who want to enjoy nature and test their abilities. The organizer is the Mountaineering Society "Kablar" Čačak, which this year celebrates 75 years of existence and guarantees good organization and safety during the race.
course_highlights: 22.4 km in length with 1600 m of cumulative ascent
Technically demanding rock sections and two peaks of Kablara (889 and 885 m)
Views of the Western Morava River, Ovčar, Jelica, and Debela Gora
additional: The race is certified and carries 1 ITRA point. The time limit is 4 hours for competitors of the PSS national series and 5 hours for others. Start and finish are at the Natural History Center in Ovčar Banja. The organizer provides good marking and safety on the trail. The route is certified, counts towards the PSS series, proper equipment is mandatory, and prizes are provided for the top finishers. The race is part of the national mountain running series and marks the 75th anniversary of PD "Kablar".

name: Otvoreno prvenstvo Fruške gore u planinskom trčanju
price_range: 1200 dinara za startninu, 1000 dinara za majicu
description: The Fruška Gora Mountain Running Open Championship is a traditional race held on the beautiful trails of the Fruška Gora National Park, starting and finishing at the Stražilovo Mountain Lodge. The race offers two challenging loops through forest terrain with a dirt surface, providing runners the opportunity to test their physical fitness and enjoy nature. Organizers from ARK Fruška Gora have prepared two races: a shorter 5.31 km race and a longer 10.62 km race, with significant ascents and an interesting trail profile. This event gathers runners of various categories and offers a unique opportunity for a sports challenge in the heart of nature.
course_highlights: The trail is circular, forested, and run on a dirt surface
The trail length is 5.31 km with an elevation of +/- 297 m
Start and finish at the Stražilovo Mountain Lodge
additional: Registration center open from 9:00 to 11:30. The main race starts at 12:00, the shorter race at 12:15. Winners will be announced at 13:30. The time limit for the 5 km race is 90 minutes, and for the 10 km race three hours. The price of the race t-shirt is 1,000 dinars, reservations via email. Online registration is closed, registrations are possible on race day. The competition takes place in a forested trail environment on Fruška Gora, with the possibility of registration on race day. Participants can expect challenging terrains and beautiful landscapes, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and love for nature.

name: Zapad Fruške Gore 2026
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a sports competition and recreational event held on Fruška Gora, known for its old trails and new challenges. The race includes various routes, such as an ultra-extreme marathon, ultra marathon, middle, and small trails, tailored to different levels of runners. The event gathers nature and running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience through the beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora. Organizers strive to ensure good organization and support for participants throughout the event.
course_highlights: Ultra-extreme marathon with 5 ITRA points
Middle Eastern marathon with 3 ITRA points
Apprentice Southern marathon with 1 ITRA point
additional: Transportation to the marathon start from Novi Sad is organized on Saturday at 6 AM. There is an option to register on-site on Saturday at Popovica for FUN routes. Start packages are collected before the race. Races are scored according to the ITRA system for different routes. Participants can expect various race categories, including ultra, middle, and beginner routes, with the possibility of online registration. The event is part of a broader manifestation promoting sport and nature in Fruška Gora.

name: Reciklažni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
description: The Recycling Marathon in Novi Sad is a traditional race held for the 11th time, marking the end of the running year. This event has an international character and gathers runners from the region. The race is known for its relaxed atmosphere and camaraderie, with a unique feature of recycling medals and plaques from previous races. The start is from Sunčani Kej, and runners receive certificates for the distances they complete, motivating those attempting a half marathon or marathon for the first time.
course_highlights: Start from Sunčani Kej, opposite Đački igralište
Race without giving up, everyone receives certificates for the completed distance
Recycling medals and plaques from previous races
additional: The marathon begins at 10:00 AM, the half marathon at 11:00 AM. ARK "Fruška Gora" Club celebrates its 15th anniversary at this event. Runners from the region traditionally participate, and the race is known for its positive atmosphere and support for recreational athletes. The Recycling Marathon promotes medal recycling and camaraderie, with the start at Sunčani Kej, distances include marathon and half marathon, and the event has a relaxed character.

name: Deliblatska Peščara 2026

description: Deliblatska Peščara 2026 is a one-day hiking event organized by PSK Pobeda, held in the beautiful environment of Deliblatska Peščara near Čardak. Participants can choose between two hiking groups, with trails ranging from 8 to 16 kilometers, leading through rolling terrains of sand dunes and groves. The trail is easy with negligible elevation change, suitable for individuals with light to moderate fitness. After hiking, participants have a rest break and an organized lunch with hot soup and refreshments. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy nature and socialize in a mountaineering spirit.
course_highlights: Trails through rolling terrains of sand dunes and groves
Two hiking groups: 15-16 km or 8-10 km
Easy trail with negligible elevation change
additional: Departure is at 7:30 from Nebojšina Street near the Holy Savior Church. Recommended equipment includes protection against wind, rain, and cold, good hiking shoes, layered clothing, a thermos or water bottle (minimum 1 liter), a flashlight, and hiking poles. For the organized lunch, prior notice and registration with the guide are required. Return to Belgrade is planned between 18:30 and 19:00. Participants must bring a mountaineering membership card, health and personal ID. Seating arrangements in the bus are made by the guide based on registration and payment order. Hiking through Deliblatska Peščara requires appropriate gear, registration with fee, and participant responsibility.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run is a New Year's race held at Kalemegdan in Belgrade, with the goal of entering 2027 with energy and a positive spirit. The race takes place at a historic site, Kalemegdan Fortress, and represents a new sports tradition of the city. Participants can choose between two distances, 5.5 km and 11 km (two laps), and part of the registration fee is donated to vulnerable individuals or groups. Organizers from the sports association Samo Hrabro guarantee a good atmosphere and quality organization, along with an entertainment program before, during, and after the race.
course_highlights: Routes of 5.5 km and 11 km (two laps)
Race held at Kalemegdan Fortress, at the viewpoint near the main promenade
Entertainment program before, during, and after the race
additional: Participant packages include a running shirt for registrations made by November 23. Each participant contributes to a humanitarian campaign. Official results will be published on runtrace.net. There are absolute male and female categories, and the top three places receive trophies. Information about pickup of race kits and program details will be announced later. The winter race registration is open until December 15, with a shirt included for early registrations, limited to 1500 participants, with options to participate in the entertainment program and after-party.

name: Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is the last race of the year intended for trail running, hiking, and Nordic walking enthusiasts. Participants can choose between two routes, 10 km for a shorter dynamic tour and 17 km for a greater challenge. The race starts at Iriški Venac, and after finishing, participants can enjoy socializing with hot mulled wine and tea. This event offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape of Fruška Gora and end the year actively and in good company.
course_highlights: Routes of 10 km and 17 km through the nature of Fruška Gora
Start at Iriški Venac with a winter atmosphere
Refreshments with hot drinks and socializing at the finish line
additional: Participants need shoes with crampons for safe walking on uneven terrain. During the race, stations with water and juices are provided, and at the finish line, refreshments with water, electrolytes, and energy drinks. All participants receive a medal as a reminder of the challenge completed. Registration on race day is possible if there are available start numbers, but without a T-shirt and at a higher fee. Two routes (10 km and 17 km), start at Iriški Venac, socializing with hot mulled wine and tea, winter landscapes of Fruška Gora.

name: 7. Winter Trail Race na Fruškoj gori
description: The Fruška Gora Marathon is a traditional sports-competition-recreational event held on Fruška Gora. The race includes various routes, from ultra-extreme to preparatory, with challenging ascents and beautiful natural surroundings. Participants can enjoy the challenges and beauty of mountain terrain while competing in a unique atmosphere. The event gathers runners of all levels and promotes a healthy lifestyle and love for nature.
course_highlights: Varied routes with ITRA scoring from 1 to 5
Mountain terrain with significant ascents and descents
Beautiful landscapes of Fruška Gora and natural environment
additional: The races are scored according to the ITRA system with different difficulty categories (1 to 5 ITRA). There are ultra-extreme, ultra, middle, small, and preparatory marathons. The preparatory southern marathon is 22 km long with an ascent and descent of 898 meters. Both group and fun registration systems are available for shorter routes. The event takes place in April, and the 7th Winter Trail Race on Fruška Gora is in December. Participation includes various route lengths, and the event is part of a series of races on Fruška Gora, focusing on trail and mountaineering sports. Registration details are not available.
